authMode.title: Authentication mode
authMode.description: token: personal access token (gitee-token secret). oauth: OAuth2 bearer token (gitee-oauth-token secret).

defaultPageSize.title: Items per page
defaultPageSize.description: How many repositories, pull requests and issues the panel asks Gitee for at once.

refreshSeconds.title: Panel cache (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How long fetched lists are reused before the panel asks Gitee again.

preferredRemote.title: Preferred remote
preferredRemote.description: Which Gitee remote to use when a project has several (its name; the first Gitee remote wins when it is not Gitee).

confirmBeforeWrite.title: Confirm before changing anything on Gitee
confirmBeforeWrite.description: Ask before merging, approving, commenting, closing issues or creating repositories.

requireIssueInCommit.title: Require an issue reference in commit messages
requireIssueInCommit.description: The commit check warns when the message names no Gitee issue (e.g. #12).
